title: Decoration Load Revalidation
acceptance: Saved placements in house, pen, exhibit, track, entrance or margin keep-outs are stored safely before rendering; entitlements remain owned.
Valid placements survive save/load unchanged at tiers 0–2 and every plot orientation; malformed and boundary data have meaningful specs.
Repairs are reported; check.sh and Studio rejoin evidence pass; schema changes, if needed, require jg approval.
